newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai finance association to hold press conference.
newsitem.headline: Thai finance association to hold press conference.

text.p: Thailand's Association of Finance Companies said it is scheduled to hold a news conference at 0800 GMT to clarify the central bank's order on Friday that 16 finance companies stop operations.
The association is expected to detail its support for the authorities' latest policy to force mergers among finance companies, an association official told Reuters.
Earlier on Friday Thai authorities told 16 listed and unlisted finance companies to stop operations and submit plans within two to consolidate and merge.

They said that there are five core companies with which the 16 firms could merge. They are are Dhana Siam Finance and Securities Plc, Nava Finance and Securities Plc, National Finance and Securities Plc, Phatra Thanakit Finance and Securities Plc and Krungthai Thanakit Plc.

The plan to force finance company mergers comes on the heels of a crisis in Thailand's ailing and cash-strapped financial sector, which has been hit hard by the worst economic downturn in over a decade.
